about: ARM64 (aarch64) installers for Try Linux for Mac and Try Linux for Linux on ARM64 PCs, found and checked the same way as distros.json (its x86_64 counterpart): 'base' is an official mirror folder, each step is added to it (a step starting with ~ is a regex matched against the folder's links, newest first), and 'checksum' names the official SHA-256 or SHA-512 checksum file next to the ISO. Distributions you download from their website are in distros.json, for every architecture.
